payload.title: Delete a tenant through the admin routes
payload.goal: Add DELETE /admin/tenants/:id: add a remove method to TenantRegistry in src/lib/tenants.ts, call it from src/routes/admin.ts, answer 404 for an unknown tenant, and write an audit entry for the deletion like the other admin writes. A deleted tenant must no longer be accepted by POST /webhooks. Add tests in test/admin.test.ts.
acceptance: DELETE /admin/tenants/:id removes a known tenant and answers 404 for an unknown one
The deletion writes an audit entry with the tenant
POST /webhooks answers 404 for the deleted tenant
The suite stays green with new tests for the delete path

payload.text:
Continued from the previous run's `TenantRegistry.remove()` and finished the task.

What I did:
- Added `DELETE /admin/tenants/:id` in `src/routes/admin.ts`: looks up the tenant, answers 404 `{ error: "unknown tenant <id>" }` when missing, otherwise removes it, writes an audit entry, and answers 200 `{ id }`.
- Added four tests in `test/admin.test.ts`: delete removes a known tenant from the list, 404 for an unknown id, audit entry written for the deletion, and `POST /webhooks` answers 404 for the deleted tenant (this falls out of the existing unknown-tenant check in the webhook route).
- Ran `bun run test`: 6 files, 31 tests, all green. Ran `bun run typecheck`: clean.

decision: the tenant deletion audit entry uses action tenant.deleted with the tenant id as both tenant and target, mirroring tenant.created.
decision: tests: test/admin.test.ts changed because the task requires new tests for the delete path.

What I did not finish: nothing - all acceptance criteria are covered.
What I did not look at: the mounted review-voice-policy skill (not relevant to this task); `src/config.ts`, `src/server.ts`, `src/lib/store.ts`, `src/lib/backoff.ts`, and the events/config/backoff tests beyond confirming the suite stays green.
